about: Android share target: text, links and files shared to the installed app arrive in a chooser (a new item, or added to an item's notes). The service worker keeps the share in a cache; the page reads it once. An option (shareIn, off by default) switches it on; while off, a share says so and keeps nothing.

files.line: { key: 'shareIn', label: 'Receive shares from other apps', sub: 'This device. Android, installed app only' },

docs: share-in: works in the installed app on Android only (Chrome's share target; iOS and desktop browsers never offer the app). The switch is Settings > Features (option shareIn, this device, off until turned on); a share that arrives while it is off says so and keeps nothing.

share-in: the chooser is app/src/share/share-sheet.js (a new item with the share's title as text and its text and link as notes, or added to an item's notes; make the fields the app's own). Files in a share are not kept: hand them to the files recipe's attach there. sw.js's VERSION is stamped at deploy, so no bump by hand.
